title: Havells Gracia Alkaline Max Water Purifier
subtitle: 10 Stages of RO & UV Hot, Warm & Ambient Water With Touch Display
category: Home Appliances > Water Purifiers > UV Water Purifiers
key_features: Futuristic Design : Featuring a classy design with Stainless Steel Tank, the water purifier comes in Grey & Black. It has a Touch option with dispensing of Hot or Warm or Ambient water.

Best in class Purification Technology : Triple Protection Technology : 100 % RO + Germicidal UV column + Germicidal UV LED, Powerful 10 stage Purification provides absolute safe drinking water. Bacteriostatic Alkaline Technology, It improves the pH of purified water by adding back wide spectrum of natural minerals & trace elements, transforms regular water into Alkaline Water, which is healthier & tastier. Revitalizer restructures water molecules for improved hydration, and mineral absorption.

Convenience Features : Features iProtect purification monitoring that cuts off water if it is no longer safe to drink. UV LED provided on tank for 24 x 7 tank sanitation. Other features include Smart indications & error alerts.

Installation & Warranty : Experience best in class care 360 service & manufacturers standard warranty cover for 1 year. * T&C apply (refer to attachment). Cover your product with attractive extended warranty plans to enjoy life long safe and healthy drinking water.
